question: In 2015, MN Subramaniam Endowment Award - The Music Academy Madras was awarded to______________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Alarmel Valli.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alarmel Valli:-**

 
 
• **She is a leading Indian classical dancer and choreographer and the foremost exponent of the Pandanallur style in the Indian classical dance form, Bharatanatyam. **
 
• She is widely acclaimed for her ability to turn traditional grammar into deeply internalized, personal dance poetry. 
 
• Valli has been honored with zahlreiche awards and recognitions for her contributions to **Bharatanatyam, including the Padma Shri (1991), the Padma Bhushan (2004), and the Chevalier of Arts and Lettres (2004).**
 
• **In 2015 she was awarded MN Subramaniam Endowment Award - The Music Academy Madras.**
 
• She is a true icon of Bharatanatyam and one of the most respected dancers in the world today.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna Ella:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian scientist and entrepreneur. **
 
• He is the founder, chairman, and managing director of Bharat Biotech, a leading biotechnology company that has developed over 12 vaccines, including Covaxin, India's first indigenous COVID-19 vaccine.
 
 
 
• **Mahaboob Subhani:-**
 
 
• He is a renowned Indian nadhaswaram artist.
 
• He was born in Prakasam district, Andhra Pradesh, India, in a family of musicians.
 
• His father, Kothapalli Sheikh Meera Sahib, and his maternal grandfather, Nadhabrahma Nadaswara Ganakala Prapoorna Janab Sheikh Chinna Peer Sahib, were also nadhaswaram artists.
